apps.name: Duotone
apps.subtitle: YouTube e Spotify numa só biblioteca
apps.localizedDescription: Make music yours. Tune each track, take control across iPhone and Windows, discover new favourites and build playlists with friends.

versions.localizedDescription:
The real iOS 26 tab bar, glass opacity you can set, and a tidier mini player.

Duotone for iPhone 7.3.2

New
- Liquid Glass: the tabs are now the system tab bar, so you can hold the selected tab and drag the glass lens from tab to tab.
- Customise: a Glass opacity slider under Liquid Glass, from clear glass to a dark capsule.
- Up next: an X on the "Back to …" row hides it.

Improved
- Liquid Glass: the mini player capsule is now smaller than the tab bar, and its artwork has rounded corners and sits centred.

Fixed
- The mini player artwork had almost square corners; they are rounded again.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.3.1...ios-v7.3.2

Liquid Glass you can see through.

Duotone for iPhone 7.3.1

Fixed
- Liquid Glass: the tab bar and the mini player are now clear glass, so what scrolls underneath shows through. In 7.3.0 they came out dark and opaque.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.3.0...ios-v7.3.1

Liquid Glass done properly, presets you can edit again, and playlists that open without a jump.

Duotone for iPhone 7.3.0

Improved
- Liquid Glass, redone: the tabs and the mini player float in two separate glass capsules, as in iOS 26, and a highlight follows your finger as you swipe between tabs. Turn it on in Customise.

Fixed
- Holding a preset in Customise no longer closes the app. Rename, Update to current look and Delete are back.
- Opening a playlist: the cover lands in its place, without landing low and jumping up.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.8...ios-v7.3.0

See your look change as you customise, try Liquid Glass, and find any setting in seconds.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.8

New
- Customise shows the app live: Now Playing next to Home or a playlist, changing as you adjust. "Next song" previews the colours of what's coming up.
- Liquid Glass: on iOS 26, turn it on in Customise for the tab bar, the mini player and the player's buttons in glass. Off by default.
- Background follows the song: the artwork's colour washes the top of every page and changes with the music. Off by default, in Customise.
- Search in Settings: type a name or what it does, and it opens the right section and lights up the setting.

Improved
- Settings show the one or two options you use most in each section. "More" opens the rest right there.
- Shuffle goes through the whole list before repeating, even when you shuffle again or reopen the app.

Fixed
- Opening a playlist: the cover lands in its place, without jumping up when the songs arrive.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.7...ios-v7.2.8

Playlists and artists now open without the page changing under you, and going back no longer blows up the cover.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.7

Improved
- Opening a playlist shows its cover, name and buttons right away. Only the songs wait, in their place.
- Opening an artist shows the songs once, already complete and in the right order. Before, the list changed several times while it loaded.
- Coming back to an artist's page no longer reloads it.

Fixed
- Swiping back from a playlist or an artist: the cover shrinks from where it is on the page to its card, instead of growing to the size of the screen.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.6...ios-v7.2.7

The 3D cover's sides now change with the Eclipse, and your friends see what you're playing without the delay.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.6

Fixed
- On the 3D cover, the sides now change when the Eclipse covers the front, instead of showing the next song's cover first.
- What you're playing reaches your friends right away again after a dropped connection. Before, it could stay on an old song for minutes.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.5...ios-v7.2.6

Choose your own playlist cover, signing in works again, and a smoother Eclipse skip.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.5

New
- Choose your own playlist cover: open a playlist's menu and pick "Choose cover…" to use any photo. "Change cover…" and "Remove cover" are there once it has one. Friends who can see the playlist see the cover too.

Fixed
- Signing in works again. On 7.2.3, signing in failed with "Cannot read property 'removeItem' of undefined", and you could be signed out when your session renewed.
- The Eclipse skip animation passes smoothly again on the 3D cover.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.3...ios-v7.2.5

Faster skips, and a way to switch Spotify accounts when importing.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.3

Improved
- Skipping to a song that hasn't finished preloading (several skips in a row, or right after a song starts) gets it playing sooner: the download now fetches its pieces in parallel.

Fixed
- Importing from your Spotify account now shows which account you're signed in with, and "Use another account" lets you sign out and log in with a different one.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.2...ios-v7.2.3

Fixes the app getting stuck on "Offline" with a working connection, on Wi-Fi and mobile data.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.2

Fixed
- The app no longer gets stuck on "Offline · downloaded liked songs only" while you have internet, including with DNS profiles that block Google: your session and full library come back as soon as the connection answers.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.2.0...ios-v7.2.2

Save your Customise looks as presets, and pages now open the moment you tap them.
Artists open straight into their photo, the original app icon can be chosen again, and long-press menus never cover the song.

Duotone for iPhone 7.2.0

New
- Presets in Customise: save the look you have now with a name, apply it with a tap, and hold it to rename, update or delete it.

Improved
- Playlists, albums and artists open right away: the page appears under the cover while it is still flying, with no wait on a black screen.
- Opening an artist turns their circle straight into the full-width photo, with no swap at the end.
- Swiping back shrinks the page into its card's cover instead of a dark box.
- Long-pressing a song lifts it with rounded corners, and its menu opens below or above it, never on top.
- Albums save as a playlist from a + button in the top corner.
- Flowing lyrics are now off by default; turn them on in Customise › Lyrics.

Fixed
- The Original app icon can be selected again after choosing another one.
- The back arrow no longer shows a page slide behind the cover.
- The 3D cover's sides no longer switch to the next song before the eclipse covers the front.

Minimum version: 7.1.0

Full changelog: https://github.com/joaoafonso2004/duotone/compare/ios-v7.1.0...ios-v7.2.0
